summary.name: MediaWiki
summary.one_liner: MediaWiki is the open-source wiki software package that powers Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects; this page is a Wikimedia Phabricator source page that returned a 429 "Too many requests" error instead of content.
summary.what_it_does: The page itself is an error page (HTTP 429, Too many requests) from Wikimedia's Phabricator source browser for the mediawiki repository, so it shows no software content. It advises reporting issues from a different location or browser and includes request/cache details for Wikimedia system administrators. The listing on awesome-selfhosted describes MediaWiki as the wiki software package behind Wikipedia and all other Wikimedia projects, serving hundreds of millions of users monthly, with a demo and source code available, licensed GPL-2.0 and written in PHP. Those facts come from the listing, not from this page.
